name: Tree View
description: A hierarchical disclosure list with keyboard navigation and selection.
usage:
<TreeView
  aria-label="Project files"
  items={[
    { id: 'src', label: 'src', children: [{ id: 'app', label: 'App.tsx' }] },
  ]}
/>

anatomy.description: The role="tree" list, named by a required aria-label.
role="treeitem" rows with aria-expanded on parents and aria-selected on the selection.
Chevron that expands or collapses a parent without selecting it.
role="group" lists holding each parent's children.

dos: Always pass an aria-label naming the tree.
Use it only for genuinely hierarchical data like files or categories.
donts: Don't render flat lists as trees; use List instead.
Don't put interactive controls inside rows; keep the single-focus tree pattern.

examples.title: Hierarchy
examples.description: Arrows expand, collapse, and move; Enter selects with aria-selected.

examples.title: Default expansion
examples.description: Open key branches on first render with defaultExpandedIds.

guidance.useWhen: Content is genuinely hierarchical, like files or nested categories.
guidance.avoidWhen: The list is flat; use a plain list or Tabs.
guidance.behavior: Arrow keys expand, collapse, and move; Enter selects.
guidance.responsive: Indent scales with depth; keep labels truncating, not wrapping.

keyboard.action: Expands a collapsed parent, or moves to its first child.
Collapses an expanded parent, or moves to its parent.

notes: Renders a role="tree" named by its required aria-label, with role="group" lists for children.
Parents expose aria-expanded; the selected item sets aria-selected.
Toggle chevrons and icons are aria-hidden; state comes from the treeitem semantics.
